meta.note: Illustrative sample data. Source of truth for the AI Control Tower space; embedded into index.html by `npm run sync:control-tower`. The budget rows for Data & AI Platform and Legal & Compliance are assumed values added so that team rows add up to the stated ceiling and actual.

risks.title: AI-driven instability spike
risks.description: CFR 9.1% ↑, Rework 12.8% ↑. ~1,500 extra failed deploys/month at 30k scale.
risks.progressNote: Test gate spec done; implementation pending
risks.action: Mandatory AI-PR test gates in design. CFR dashboard alert threshold set at 8%.

risks.title: Overprivileged agent identities (31)
risks.description: 10 agents with full admin write to SAP S/4HANA & BTP prod. 21 exceed least-privilege scope.
risks.action: Weekly remediation sprints. 2 critical (L2C orch + report bot) blocked on SAP API key reissue.

risks.title: 47 unregistered AI assets
risks.description: BTP extension agent (confidential data), n8n prod LLM node, Joule skill #7 + 44 more. No owner, no token cap.
risks.action: BTP extension agent escalated to CISO. Auto-registration pipeline under review.

risks.title: Hallucination in financial outputs
risks.description: 14 incidents/month. AI-generated SAP GL figures used in reports without HITL gate.
risks.action: HITL gate design complete. 7 deployed, 5 pending ServiceNow workflow integration.

risks.title: Shadow AI (89 flagged accounts)
risks.description: Personal ChatGPT / Claude accounts. Real number estimated 10× higher at 30k scale. No auditability.
risks.progressNote: SSO enforced for 40 of 89 flagged accounts
risks.action: Acceptable use policy refresh published. Network egress block on personal AI endpoints pending.

risks.title: EU AI Act — 18 high-risk agents
risks.description: 18 agents require conformity assessment before the 12 Dec 2026 audit. 10 outstanding.
risks.action: External assessor engaged. Remaining 10 scheduled Nov–early Dec. Audit prep kicked off.

risks.title: Prompt injection via untrusted content
risks.description: Agents reading external emails, docs, web content. 0 confirmed incidents this quarter.
risks.progressNote: Content isolation active on all 186 agents
risks.action: Monitoring alerts configured. Quarterly red-team exercise scheduled Q1 2027.
risks.tile: Prompt injection defence 100% complete across all 186 agents
